resources.string: Release a prefix key, then press an app key
Register, change or remove an app for each second key
App unavailable — select to change or remove

Only active with an empty, focused search field. After normal typing, shortcuts remain blocked until a new input session (for example, leave and return to KISS). IME composition takes priority. Keys intercepted by Android, the IME or device shortcuts cannot be used. Space, Tab, Caps Lock and letter keys require verification on your device. Caps Lock may also change the system caps state.
